description:
Return a list of all Configurable Field Sets associated with a Project.

**Filtering by field set type: project vs. company endpoints**

The project and company list endpoints use different query parameters to filter by type:

- **Project list (this endpoint):** `types[]`. The company-style `filters[type][]` (or a single `filters[type]`) is also accepted. If both are sent, the values are merged and field sets matching any listed type are returned.
- **Company list** (`GET /rest/v2.1/companies/{company_id}/configurable_field_sets`): `filters[type][]` only. `types[]` is ignored on the company endpoint.

Type values are Configurable Field Set class names, for example `ConfigurableFieldSet::Vendor`, `ConfigurableFieldSet::Observations::Item`, or `ConfigurableFieldSet::EquipmentCategory::Category` (Equipment Register). A misspelled or unrecognized class name causes the request to fail rather than being ignored.

Examples:

```
GET /rest/v2.1/companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/configurable_field_sets?types[]=ConfigurableFieldSet::EquipmentCategory::Category
GET /rest/v2.1/companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/configurable_field_sets?filters[type][]=ConfigurableFieldSet::EquipmentCategory::Category
GET /rest/v2.1/companies/{company_id}/configurable_field_sets?filters[type][]=ConfigurableFieldSet::Vendor
```

parameters.name: include_default_configurable_field_sets
parameters.description: Flag to include the default values for each type of Configurable Field Set if one has not been created.

id.description: The unique identifier of the configurable field set.

name.description: The name of the configurable field set.

type.description: The type of configurable field set

category.description: Specifies the category for the configurable field set if it exists or an empty string. This property was added for the ConfigurableFieldSet::Observations::Item class.

class_name.description: Specifies the class the configurable field set is associated with.

fields.description: Specifies the hash of fields on an object. This is for example purposes only.

sections.description: An array of sections that are used for custom fields.

inspection_type_id.description: The unique identifier of the inspection type.

incident_type_id.description: The unique identifier of the incident type.

contract_type.description: The contract type of a commitment line item field set: purchase_order or work_order (subcontract). Null for other field set types.

generic_tool_id.description: The unique idenfitier of the generic tool.

action_plan_type_id.description: The unique idenfitier of the action plan type.

observations_category_id.description: The unique identifier of the observations category.

has_custom_fields.description: Indicates whether the configurable field set has any custom fields defined.

has_custom_fields_sections.description: Indicates whether the configurable field set has custom fields organized into sections.
